frozen_nonselectable_random_controls.random_key: SHA-256 UTF-8 canonical tuple(seed,outer_fold,session,decision_time_ns,source_neutral_contract_id,expiry_yyyymmdd,strike_milli_points,right_code); interpret the first unsigned 64 big-endian bits as a rank and the full digest as the tie-break
schedule_construction: freeze the candidate's serial action trace and intent counts before reading any realized path or PnL label
derive the registered intent budget by session, side, moneyness band, and decision-time premium band from that label-blind trace
within each cell, rank every causally legal universal-grid minute and eligible exact contract by random_key
take the first required count without replacement; when the cell has too few legal pairs, mark the seed schedule incomplete
replay the complete schedule through its own causal t+1 fills, occupancy, D48, D49, soft-close, daily-stop, neutral lifecycle, and separate $3/$4 ledgers
frozen_nonselectable_random_controls.matching_is_not_a_search: all eight schedules are generated once; every identity, complete or incomplete, enters the ordered multiplicity and validity ledger

post_replay_matching.opportunity_set: same governed fold/session universal grid and exact intent budget

frozen_nonselectable_random_controls.validity: every one of the eight schedules must be complete and pass the frozen post-replay matching table; any failure yields INSUFFICIENT_MATCHED_CONTROL with no replacement attempt
frozen_nonselectable_random_controls.aggregate: when all eight are valid, report each separately and a nonselectable equal-weight mean across the eight session-level comparator values
frozen_nonselectable_random_controls.ft2_11_dependency: FT2-11 repair includes all eight individual contrasts, the fixed aggregate, incomplete attempts, and every control validity outcome in multiplicity and terminal precedence

strong_shuffle_identities.permutation: sort model-fit target-row identities by the same SHA-256 random_key and assign target bundles in that order, preserving each row's full target bundle while destroying its original feature identity

extension_channel_ledger.rule: every owner-admitted active-channel set and every separately selectable channel ablation is preregistered before outcomes
extension_channel_ledger.ft2_11_dependency: all selectable channel sets and invalidating ablations enter multiplicity

d1_v2.full_ladder_extension: Randomize both timing and exact contract over the full governed risk set without model features or outcome labels, then apply the frozen serial replay and exposure-matching table.
